text:
jeff_marketing: Hey team — prepping the launch announcement for Friday 10:00 PT. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/announcements/draft-v2.3 — need quick confirm on changelog & docs links, rollout/canary timing, and webinar CTA timing. Short replies pls.

sam_eng: Canary window planned 9:30–10:15 PT, ramp 10:15–10:45 PT. We're pinning traffic to model v2.3.0 for the first wave. Docs should be up by 08:00 PT.

maria_docs: Uploading now — expect changelog and API diff at: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/v2.3.0/changelog. Will drop a short migration guide by 08:30.

lina_product: Webinar is 11:00 PT. Landing page asks to have CTA go live with the post, but can we delay CTA until canary green to avoid redirects breaking?

jeff_marketing: Prefer CTA live with the post for PR flow, but ok to hold if eng wants to watch canary. @sam_eng can you advise?

sam_eng: Prefer holding the CTA until 10:30 PT. If we get all-green at 10:20 we'll flip earlier. Otherwise keep CTA hidden and show a simple 'Join webinar' link without demo signup.

tony_sales: Routing ask — enterprise demo leads should hit AE queue directly. Add ?source=launch&utm_campaign=v2.3 and set payload tag=priority so routing rules pick them up.

jeff_marketing: We'll append utm_campaign=launch-v2.3 and add tag param to forms. Also will add a short sentence in the announcement pointing enterprise customers to the AE form.

maria_docs: Changelog blurb for the post (copy suggestion):

```
v2.3.0 — release notes (short):
- Prefix/KV cache improvements to reduce repeat-token work
- Batcher and kernel selection tuning for long-tail latency SLOs
- Safer rollout with automatic fallback to v2.2-quant on capacity pressure
```

sam_eng: Add a note in the release notes about fallback policy and how to interpret the Console 'fallback' badge. Also add rollback steps (one-liner) in docs.

jeff_marketing: Good call — we'll include a 1-line callout.

maria_docs: Done — changelog anchor is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/v2.3.0#changelog. Also added migration snippet for API users.

jeff_marketing: Quick ops Qs: who owns the /changelog anchor push? @maria_docs — confirmed. Who posts the 10:00 PT announcement? I'll post it and pair with marketing-bot for syndication. Who watches canary at 9:30? @sam_eng + @anna_sre please.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: release/2.3.0 planned @ 2026-03-27T17:00:00Z — workflow: build -> smoke -> canary -> promote. Status: pending.

sam_eng: I'll be on standby with @anna_sre (SRE). Ping the thread at 10:10 PT with a short checklist: smoke passed, latency baseline ok, no errors > 0.5% on p95.

lina_product: Copy tweak request: change 'significant latency improvements' -> 'latency SLO improvements for long-tail requests' (more precise).

jeff_marketing: Done — updated copy in the draft doc. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/announcements/draft-v2.3 (last updated 09:10 PT).

maria_docs: Confirmed docs + changelog + anchors. Also added the landing page snippet for the webinar CTA pointing to https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-v2-3 with UTM params.

jeff_marketing: Final plan summary:
- Post announcement 10:00 PT with social syndication but CTA button hidden.
- Canary monitored 9:30–10:15 PT; if green by 10:20, enable CTA (target 10:30).
- Webinar CTA becomes active at 11:05 PT.
- Inbound lead links include utm_campaign=launch-v2.3 and tag=priority for AE routing.

I will post the final draft at 09:10 PT for last signoff. Please react with :thumbsup: or quick 'ack' if aligned.

sam_eng: ack — will sign off at 09:30 PT if smoke + canary look good.

jeff_marketing: thanks all :rocket:
